events.title: DEAD HEAD REDEMPTION – Album Launch
events.location: The Cave Inn, 47 Balaclava St, Woolloongabba, Qld, 4102, 47 Balaclava St, Woolloongabba, QLD, Australia
events.description: It's been a hard road but this wagon train has finally pulled up! DEAD HEAD REDEMPTION are proud to launch their debut album THE WENDIGO HUNTERS here at THE CAVE INN on Saturday September 19th 2026.    With support from fellow 4017-ers IRESON ROAD and THE COASTAL COWGIRLS, this will be a night of Hickory-smoked entertainment that's sure to tickle the nostalgia buds.    NZ brother and tireless publican Adam Christy, of Cardigan Bar and State of Appalachia fame, brings his new project IRESON ROAD to their debut at the Cave. From gritty blues to powerful dark country ballads, we are set for an emotional ride into the sunset, accompanied by wailing guitar and heartbreaking vocals.    Playful, talented, and gosh-darn rootin'-tootin', Sandgate's THE COASTAL COWGIRLS are a female-led bayside band that blend the dusty trails of country & Americana with the refreshing breeze of the coast. Delightful originals, river-washed classics, and yee-haw surprises are these boot-stomping blonde's buttercake.    Closing the evening, DEAD HEAD REDEMPTION perform their brand-new album The Wendigo Hunters in full from start to finish. Evolved over the past three years, the songs evoke the atmosphere of the mangroves, the dankness of the swamp, and the harshness of the open land. Weaving tales of folklore, injustice, and murder, the songs tramp the trail between blues, outlaw, and pure rock n' roll. Following the closing track, they'll bring the night to a head with more originals, and a few rusty rail reworks for good measure!    [button link="https://events.humanitix.com/dead-head-redemption-album-launch"] Tickets[/button]

events.title: Vermillion High Showcase 2026
events.location: The Cave Inn, 47 Balaclava St, Woolloongabba, Qld, 4102, 47 Balaclava St, Woolloongabba, QLD, Australia
events.description: What is Vermilion High?     Vermilion High is a program initiated by QUT’s student-run record label Vermilion Records. The program is the first of its kind in the country and offers a few talented high school musicians the chance to participate in a collaborative production process with final-year creative arts undergraduates from QUT.    For final-year QUT students, at the brink of emerging into their own professional careers, they are able to refine their skills in the music business through production, marketing, artist liaising, and event management, to name just a few.    For the Vermilion High students, these lucky young artists gain the opportunity to professionally record their original music at a state-of-the-art facility.    It's a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, and the Vermilion High program empowers these emerging artists to showcase their talent to the real world.    The artists performing include:    Evie May    Braden Judge    Sophie Nicholls    Kira Green    Liv Welsh    Sabrina Rees    Seb Tyne    Prom In The Woods    Glass Rain    Ethan Dahl    Asher Iyer    Ruby Elizabeth    [button link="https://pay.qut.edu.au/FCIEDUSJCONFERENECES/booking?UDS_ACTION=S1I&UDS_ACTION_DATA=FVxWcjdAXQROXVECNEJDBS1SQnRBXUQbVTJALARBUDEBRllS"] Tickets[/button]    Vermilion Records - https://www.instagram.com/vermilion.records?utm_source=ig_web_button_share_sheet&igsi=ZDNlZDc0MzIxNw==    Vermilion High - https://www.instagram.com/vermilion.high?utm_source=ig_web_button_share_sheet&igsi=ZDNlZDc0MzIxNw==

events.title: Ancient Channels- Static Spirit Album Launch
events.location: The Cave Inn, 47 Balaclava St, Woolloongabba, Qld, 4102, 47 Balaclava St, Woolloongabba, QLD, Australia
events.description: Ancient Channels is a Brisbane post-punk outfit known for its swirling guitar landscapes, dream-pop sensibilities, and a cinematic approach to songwriting. The project channels a love of ’80s post punk, modern psych-pop, and atmospheric post-punk into a sound that feels expansive yet intimate.    Formed against the backdrop of Brisbane’s tightly knit independent music community, Ancient Channels quickly stood out for their ability to fuse shimmering textures with grounded, emotionally honest lyricism. Their songs unfold like scenes with rich layers of reverb, swirling effects, and melodic guitar interplay creating a sonic world that invites listeners in rather than overwhelms.The result is music that feels both nostalgic and exploratory: echoes of The Cure and Siouxsie And The Banshees woven into something distinctly their own.    Onstage, Ancient Channels delivers immersive performances marked by dynamic energy and detailed soundscapes. The band’s live sets move fluidly from atmospheric introspection to powerful crescendos, showcasing a versatility that resonates with audiences across Brisbane’s venues and festivals.    With each release, Ancient Channels continues to refine and expand their sonic palette, building a reputation as one of Brisbane’s most compelling underground acts. Their work captures the restless creativity of the city’s scene while carving out a unique identity that is textured and heartfelt.    [button link="https://events.humanitix.com/ancient-channels-static-spirit-album-launch"]Tickets[/button]
